newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Measurex rating still at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Measurex rating still at buy.

text.p: -- Barrington Investment Research Associates Inc said Tuesday it is upholding its buy rating on Measurex Corp.

-- Barrington said it believes the stock is significantly undervalued based on its long-term outlook, strong leading market share in all of its grographic markets, improving profitability and financial strength.

-- Barrington said Measurex, which develops systems that monitor computer-aided manufacturing processes, will start the new year on the slow side with modestly negative earnings comparisons because of a longer integration period for its purchase of Data Measurement Corp in early 1996.
-- Measurex shares finished down 1/2 Tuesday at 25-1/4.
